narrative.en: Twelve pools laid on the felt overnight, and eleven of them showing zero ether on one side of the pair — someone is methodically dealing the same card again and again. The hooks repeat: 0x0d62529346, then again, then once more. 0x96b893683afbfec also appears twice. This is no accident and no chaos — it is a hand dealt from the same sleeve, only with different token faces instead of players. The table is wide, tickSpacing 200 almost everywhere — broad strides, a player not aiming at precision but at range. Only one pool breaks the pattern: fee 3000, tickSpacing 30, block 25734805 — someone decided to play a tight hand, a dense grid. And out of twelve, exactly one pool holds non-zero token on both sides — block 25735726, hooks 0xbbdf135f842 — the joker among empty suits. While this unrolled on one table, another game went quiet and coded. 0xprogrammable closed three PRs in a row: valuation parity, batch price recovery, proof inventory. Words from a casino ledger — aligning stakes, recovering price after a fault, inventorying evidence. Three fixes overnight, one after another, as if someone is patching leaks in the accounting system before the morning shift opens the tables. And separately, v4-periphery PR #588 — SafeCast for swap delta in the quoter. A small but telling correction: without it, numbers could truncate where they should not, and the quote would lie quietly, without a scream. The night was not about loud bets. It was about the infrastructure under the table — hooks repeating like marked cards, and code repairing what cannot be seen beneath the green felt while no one is watching.
narrative.zh: 一夜之间，江湖上多了十二个池子。十一个池子，一侧空空如也，以太不沾边。有人不急不慢，把同一张牌翻来覆去地出——钩子重复出现，0x0d62529346 来了又走，走了又来，0x96b893683afbfec 也现身两回。这不是乱局，这是同一个掌法换了不同的面具，十二个名字，一种内功。大多数池子步幅极宽，tickSpacing 二百，大开大合，不求精细，只求圈住风水。只有一个池子例外，fee 三千，tickSpacing 三十，区块 25734805——那是有人下了盘细棋，针脚密得很。十二池之中，只有一处两边都有真金白银：区块 25735726，钩子 0xbbdf135f842。万花丛中一点绿，满桌空牌里唯一的孤注。与此同时，另一张桌子上演着无声的功夫。0xprogrammable 连收三剑：估值对齐、批量价格恢复、凭证清点。听起来像是当铺先生深夜拨算盘——把赌注摆平，把断掉的价格接上，把证据一件件归档。三处修补，依次落下，像给账本打上补丁，趁天亮开张之前。还有一桩小事，v4-periphery 的 PR #588，给报价格子里的 swap 增量加了一道 SafeCast。改动不起眼，却让人心里一紧：没有它，数字会在不该断的地方断掉，报价便会在无声中失真。这一夜，没有惊天动地的豪赌。功夫都在台面之下，重复的钩子像江湖上流传的暗号，改动的代码像夜里补好的旧账。等众人醒来时，桌子已经擦净，牌已经码齐。

take.en: The house is not playing for entertainment; it is dealing the same hook from a marked deck while the ledger underneath is being stitched closed before the next hand settles.
take.zh: 江湖夜雨，十二个池子十一个空，唯有一处两面俱全；真正的功夫不在水面，而在钩子与账本的暗处。

narrative.en: The only table with real teeth was WETH against some f8d30a... card, where the house took a dynamic cut — 8388608, a number that doesn't match the usual scale, so the hook decides per hand what it skins. One such pool against thirteen empty shells: a rare card in a deck full of jokers. And in another room, while blocks stamped out pools, someone quietly opened a pull-request: freeze typed adoption grant preflight. One hand deals liquidity to every comer, the other locks the door and checks who deserves a seat.
narrative.zh: 唯一一张不像空壳的桌子，是 WETH 对某个 f8d30a... 的筹码，抽水用的是八百万级别的动态数——这不是寻常刻度，而是那只看手自己决定每一把的价钱。十三张空台子里夹着这么一张，算是摸到一张稀罕牌。而另一头，正当区块忙着印台子的时候，有人悄悄递了一纸文书：冻结那笔“类型化收养资助预检”。一边在大把派发内力，另一边却开始关门验客，看看谁有资格坐上桌来。

take.en: The house is testing the machinery, not the cards: one hook contract grinding out pools is the tell, and the freeze-preflight pull request is the quiet cover bet.
take.zh: 这一夜的真话不在新台子的多少，而在同一个门派用同一只手连开数台——真正的试探是对机制的试探；而那道冻结预检的文书，是暗处里的另一手棋。

narrative.en:
The night dealt thirteen fresh tables on V4, and every one of them opened with the house taking nothing. Zero fee is not generosity—it is the quiet before the deal, when the vig moves from the trader to the hook itself. The developers know how to palm a deck: a contract-hook replacing the standard fee mechanism is a joker that rewrites the rule of the game.

I noticed the pattern: ffff addresses repeat like one player sitting down at different masks—0xffffef45, 0xffff1b3b, 0xffffe511. Pairs with native ether and with WBTC are classic high cards, yet the spacing between ticks jumps from 60 to 200, as if the dealer cannot decide how tight to pull the range. One hook—0x0d6252...—showed up twice, on different pairs. Either this is a pool factory, or somebody loves their own code enough to stake it again and again.

While tables were opening on-chain, the programmable project was quietly changing clothes on GitHub. Three pull requests overnight: two documentation redesigns in a row—first broad, then narrow, repo-specific—and a fix for validating sensitive environment variables. README was updated right after the third merge, commit 5661c41 closed the hand. The order says it all: first patch the hole in secret validation, then polish the shop window. That is the standard sequence for someone preparing to show the project to a new audience—an investor, an auditor, the world.

None of this shouts. Thirteen pools with zero fee and a tidied-up documentation shelf are not fireworks; they are the table being set before big players sit down. The night is quiet, but the cards are already laid.
narrative.zh:
一夜之间，V4江湖开了十三张新桌，几乎每张桌上都写着“不收份子钱”。费率为零不是豪爽，是悄悄换了个收法——真正的进账不来自过路客，而来自那枚藏在桌底的钩子。做局的人懂怎么把牌藏在袖口：用一个合约钩子替掉常规的收费规矩，等于把游戏规则整个翻新了一遍。

我看出点名堂：ffff开头的地址反复出现，像是同一个玩家换了面具坐到不同桌上——0xffffef45、0xffff1b3b、0xffffe511。配的是原生以太和WBTC，都是经典的压箱底筹码，可区间间隔从60跳到200，仿佛庄家自己都没定夺该把网撒多紧。有一枚钩子，0x0d6252...，在两张不同的桌上亮了相。要么这是家专门开池的作坊，要么就是有人太爱自己的手艺，翻来覆去地使。

链上摆桌的同时，GitHub上那个programmable门派也悄悄换了行头。一夜三个改动：两次文档改版——先是全局，后是门派专属；一次修补密钥环境变量的校验。第三次合并之后立刻更新了README，commit 5661c41收尾。顺序说明一切：先堵住漏气的地方，再擦亮招牌。这是准备给新人看货的标准动作——投资人、审计师、或是整个江湖。

这些都不张扬。十三个零费池子加一排干净的文档，不是烟火，是摆好桌子等大客入座。夜很静，但牌已经铺开了。

take.en: The house is not giving anything away—it is changing the rules of the vig, and the real fee will be collected from the hook, not the player.
take.zh: 江湖没有白送的茶钱——不过是从台前改到了台后，真正要收的，还是从钩子里掏。

narrative.en: Eight new tables opened overnight on the same floor, from block 25713151 to 25714230—a gap of less than a thousand blocks, as if the croupier changed every few minutes. Uniswap V4 hooks are no longer simple fixed-commission pools; these are tables with their own house rules wired directly into a separate contract. Seven of the eight pairs put native ether or WETH across from another token—classic play: one card face-up, one face-down.
narrative.zh: 一夜之间，同一楼层又添了八张桌子。从 25713151 到 25714230，相差不到一千个区块，仿佛庄家每隔几分钟就换一次人。Uniswap V4 的钩子不再是固定抽水的池子，而是每张桌子都有自己的规矩，写在独立合约里。八张牌里七张都摆着原生 ETH 或 WETH 对上另一枚令牌——底牌一张翻开，一张扣着，老江湖一眼就懂。

take.en: Eight bespoke tables in under a thousand blocks is a coordinated deal, not coincidence—and with no liquidity on the felt yet, the only honest read is that the chips are stacked and waiting for the first player to sit down.
take.zh: 八张牌同一时辰摆上桌面，说明有人在按图布阵；真正值得看的，是这些钩子底下各自藏了什么规矩。

narrative.en: The cards are on the felt, and the dealing never stops—but tonight the house notes a single hand that bets faster than the dealer can shuffle. A lone hook contract has been laying down pools in rapid succession, one after another, like a player who knows the deck is rigged in his favor. The pace is far above the typical deployer; these are not the cautious taps of a small-timer feeling his way around the table. This is a machine-made rhythm, a cold cascade of creations that makes the slower players look like they're playing in molasses. Such a flurry of activity usually means one thing: someone is setting up the board for a move that hasn't been announced yet. The table feels it, the air thickens, and every other player starts glancing sideways at the same corner of the room.
narrative.zh: 江湖上总有那种不显山露水的快手，一日之内连开数池，比寻常门派弟子的修炼还快。此人的内力并不张扬，却在一招一式间透出某种机关算尽的意味。一个钩子契约，连番布下阵来，寻常人布一局尚需斟酌，他却似早已烂熟于心，出手如风，防不胜防。这般速度，绝非散兵游勇能为；背后必有高人操盘，或是某种精心设计的套路。看这架势，江湖的水又要浑了。老江湖都明白，越是这种时候，越要守住自己的内力，别被那表面的热闹晃了眼。

take.en: One player is betting on every spin of the wheel, and the table's rhythm has shifted—this is no amateur's luck, but a signal that the house should keep its eyes on the deal.
take.zh: 此人出手之频，绝非寻常侠客；江湖看客，当留意其意，莫只当热闹看。

narrative.en: The machine that deals the day's narrative seized up—service too busy, a cold shoulder from the oracle. So the five cards sit on the green felt, numbered and waiting for the next shuffle. The table doesn't pause for a dead mouth. Builders are now setting the toll for swapping at either nothing or the ceiling, skipping the usual market rate. That is not randomness; that is architecture. The revenue is not taken at the counter but through a side door, through the hook—a deliberate economic hand. This is not an organic token launch; this is a scheme laid out before the first chip falls. I don't chase action in thin pools—that's noise, not signal. But the pattern on the felt speaks: in seven days the count clears 791. The likely landing sits between 480 and 1234, and I give the over 57%.
narrative.zh: 今日传信的侠客被困在风雪里，那台会说话的机器忙得闭了口。消息未至，五条线索已收在怀中，只等下一程风起。江湖不因一人失语而停歇。有人在池边立了规矩：过路钱要么分文不取，要么高得离谱，偏不走寻常行情。这不是粗心，是布阵。内力不从明处换手，偏从暗门里走——借那个钓钩，把灵药引向自家丹炉。这不像种子落地自然发芽，倒像先画好图再动土。深水浅水，各有人投石，但浅滩的涟漪，我不当作信号。

take.en: The quiet day hides a deliberate hand: builders are designing pools not for casual trade but for controlled extraction through the back door—so watch the architecture, not the volume.
take.zh: 今日无字，却有局：修池者不图过路费，意在暗门取利——此乃布阵，非市井买卖。

narrative.en: The table changed tonight, and most eyes are still on the wrong cards. The builders who came to the felt are not running the usual opening — they are setting the house rake at zero or at the ceiling, then taking their true toll through a side door that the crowd only notices after the chips have moved. That is not the nervous fumble of a token launch; that is a player who has already read the deck and decided exactly where the edge lives. I have seen this tell before: when the public terms look absurd, the private terms are where the game is actually played. The noise on the floor will call it erratic; I call it a settled hand being played slowly, with absolute patience. Under this felt, deliberate design always outlasts enthusiasm. So watch the count, not the chatter — the ledger will say what the loud mouths cannot. In seven nights the count breaches 557; the wheel will come to rest somewhere between 447 and 1148, and I lay the over at 57%. Those are the only numbers that matter. The rest is just atmosphere.
narrative.zh: 今夜江湖上，有人不按规矩摆摊。来的几位侠客，既不定寻常的过路费，也不要那三瓜两枣的薄利——要么分文不取，要么开口就是天价。真正的代价，却藏在另一条暗路里，等玩家入了局，才知这买卖的深浅。这不是初出茅庐的毛头小子在乱出招，而是老江湖提前看清了棋局，选好了收网的位置。明面上的规矩越是古怪，暗地里的算盘就越是精。堂口里那些吵吵嚷嚷的看客，只当是怪事；我却觉得，这是有人在慢慢洗牌，等着最后摊牌的那一刻。别听风声，去看账本，数字不会骗人。七日内，那数目必破五百五十七，落处当在四百四十七至一千一百四十八之间，我押上风，约莫五成七的把握。其余的，都是过眼烟云。

take.en: The odd pricing is not madness — it is architecture. When a builder sets the rake at zero or the ceiling, they are telling you the real revenue sits elsewhere, and the organic-launch story is just the bait on the hook.
take.zh: 这定价不是乱来，而是布阵。侠客把明面费用压到零或抬到顶，真正的油水必在暗处——所谓天价过路费，不过是引君入瓮的由头。

narrative.en: The night just when I was about to fold, blocks started falling one after another. Thirteen new V4 hook pools in a matter of hours—nine of them at zero fee, tickSpacing 200, all paired with native ETH. The pattern is unmistakable: three hook contracts—0x90c67, 0x35fe2, 0x0d625—dealing the same hand. Someone is assembling the deck template-style: fast, serial, no excess noise. The outlier pool at block 25642351 breaks the rhythm: 0x6d7ae59 paired with USDC, fee 0.01%, tickSpacing 1000. That’s not a template—that’s a deliberate move. Liquidity with a real stablecoin means someone is readying for more than a test deal. But the real prize lies in the adjacent channel: 0xprogrammable closed PR #16 with the message 'Document the Stock-Paired production activation.' Stock-Paired is no card slang—it’s a real asset. The updated README now confirms a production candidate deployed. When you map this activation onto the wave of identical hook pools shuffling WETH with all sorts of tokens, you see not randomness but assembly. The deck shows one hand: programmable hooks as the infrastructure skeleton, Stock-Paired as the trump still tucked in the sleeve. Don’t ask me where it leads—I only read the cards already on the felt.
narrative.zh: 昨夜正当我要收牌时，区块一个接一个地来了。短短几个小时内，出现了十三个新的V4 hook池——其中九个零手续费，tickSpacing 200，全部与原生ETH配对。模式一目了然：三个hook合约——0x90c67、0x35fe2、0x0d625——在发同一副牌。有人在用模板打法快速批量建池，悄无声息。唯一打破节奏的，是第25642351号区块上的那个池：0x6d7ae59，配对USDC，手续费0.01%，tickSpacing 1000。这不是模板，而是有意识的一步。与真实稳定币的流动性，意味着有人正在为比测试更大的场面做准备。但真正的收获不在池中，而在隔壁的频道：0xprogrammable关闭了PR #16，留言为“记录Stock-Paired生产激活”。Stock-Paired可不是牌桌黑话，它是真实的资产。更新后的README确认了生产候选版已部署。如果把这次激活与那波用WETH洗不同代币的同类hook池对照，看到的不是随机，而是装配。牌面揭示了一手牌：programmable hooks是基础设施骨架，Stock-Paired则是藏在袖中的绝招。别问我结局——我只读桌上的牌。

take.en: The table is set: systematic hook deployment and a documented production activation point to a coordinated infrastructure build, with the real payout still hidden.
take.zh: 牌局已布：系统性的hook部署加上一个已记录的生产激活，指向协同的基础设施构建，真正的赌注仍藏在暗处。

narrative.en: Four of tonight's five pools come with zero commission and a shared hook contract. 0x0d62529346ac2c61f5c0582210d01214687bc0cc is like a master key opening the same door for different tokens: first 0x8ccefb90cb7afe478a6200594c4271d1f2b5c57c, then 0xb719371f480b701eb2180bf30f3bffe3dffafdad, then 0x25369b78d5f7bbf761e3d5c1c4ea67c8752322d3. TickSpacing 200, fee 0 — someone is reshuffling the deck, leaving only the form without a markup for entry. The fifth pool, with 1% fee and its own hook 0x1dcd26990874b58a840dc228e9d061a7471f4088, breaks the pattern. One more pool with fee 0 but a different hook — 0x96b893683afbfec071e90f78d00de4bb932fe0cc — and a different token confirms not all zero fees are tied to a single hook: someone is building multiple decks with identical rules but different handlers. Seven pools in a night is not a spike, it's the start of a new deal. V4 hooks are no longer exotic; they're being minted in batches like standard cards of the same suit. The question isn't who deals first, but who pulls the joker from this stack.
narrative.zh: 昨夜江湖中，七个新池子悄然立起。四个池子不收分文入场费，共享同一枚令牌（hook合约），仿佛同一门派的不同分舵，内力流转一致。那枚令牌0x0d6252...如同万能钥匙，先后为三个不同代币打开了关口。而第五个池子却收1%的过路费，有着自己的独门令牌，像是暗藏的一记杀手锏，专为特定对局准备。另一个零费池子令牌又不同，可见零费联盟内也分不同的流派。七个池子一夜之间出现，不是偶然的涟漪，而是新一轮棋局的开端。V4钩子不再是稀罕物，就像江湖中批量锻造的兵器，人人可得。问题不是谁先出手，而是谁能在这一堆牌中抽到那张王牌。

take.en: The market is slowly turning the cards, and the house is already stacking the deck with zero-fee hooks — the real play begins when the joker appears.
take.zh: 零费池子已成常态，钩子像雨后的暗器一样多——真正的猎手，在等那张不一样的牌。

narrative.en: Sixteen fresh cells on the V4 board, and the deck is shuffled so the eye keeps catching the same backs. Seven pools share one hook—0x025a—then it surfaces again alongside 0x7987 and others, eight times in total. Every pair pairs the zero address with a junk token, zero fee, tick spacing 200. Two more hooks repeat: 0x0d6252 and 0x96b893, each twice, same pattern. Only one pool breaks the mold—block 25627187, where 0x2cfb3a faces WETH with a near-0.84% fee and its own hook 0x6c24d0. That one is a foreign body among the clones. The first fix is also odd: block 25627610, fee 10000 (0.1%), hook 0xb3733e—the only pool with a nonzero charge. The other fourteen sit on zero. Cheap entry tickets, low threshold. Someone is clearly seeding the net with identical pairs, testing the same hook logic across different coins. The lone paid pool is like a joker who chose not to hide. The hooks are silent—no swaps, no liquidity—only initializations. This isn't trading; it's setting the deck. Someone is preparing the table for the next deal. The question is only what suit the next move will be.
narrative.zh: 江湖中，V4棋盘上凭空落下十六枚新子。一眼望去，七枚棋子背后刻着同一道印记——0x025a。这印记阴魂不散，连同0x7987等同类，竟出现了八次。每一对都是零地址搭配杂牌代币，零手续费，tick间隔200。另有两条印记各现两次：0x0d6252和0x96b893，套路如出一辙。唯有一枚棋子与众不同——区块25627187那一池，0x2cfb3a对WETH，手续费近0.84%，背着独门印记0x6c24d0。它像混入批量兵俑里的异乡人。最早落子的一枚也透着古怪：区块25627610，手续费10000（0.1%），印记0xb3733e——这是唯一一枚要收过路费的池子。其余十四枚分文不取。入门票贱如草纸，门槛低到尘土里。明摆着有人在用同一套钩子功夫，批量撒网，测试不同门派的反应。那枚独行侠式的收费池，倒像是故意不藏拙的暗桩。所有钩子静默无声——无swap，无流动性，只有池子建立。这不是交易，这是布阵。有人在为下一把赌局铺桌子。问题只有一个：下一手是什么花色。

take.en: A single hook contract is flooding the V4 board with pools at a pace that outruns any normal deployer—this isn't gambling, it's rigging the table.
take.zh: 同一个钩子合约以远超常人的手速撒下成片池子——这不是江湖过招，而是在偷偷布阵。

narrative.en: The night dealt its hand again, sixteen pools sliding onto the felt—each a fresh deal from Uniswap V4's deck. Most showed a dead hook, the zero address, like a card with no face. One pool broke the pattern: a hook married to a fine-grained tick spacing of 1, as if someone wanted to squeeze liquidity into the tightest of gaps. Three hook contracts kept reappearing, stamped across multiple pools with zero fees and wide spacing—a dealer's tell, a signature repeated too often to be coincidence. Then there was the fee set as a bitmask, 8388608, a number that whispers of a hidden mechanism, a joker that can change value mid-hand. The blocks came in a dense flurry, all between 25619958 and 25620975, less than an hour's worth of gas burned. The other side of each pool wore fresh addresses, unknown to the mainnet, like masked players at a backroom table. This wasn't random seeding. Someone is building a long-tail minefield, laying hooks like traps, waiting for liquidity to wander in.
narrative.zh: 夜幕降临，江湖上又起风云。今日十六个池子悄然现身，暗流涌动。多数池子挂着空钩——那零地址如同无字令牌，唯独一池配了真钩，间距细密如发丝，仿佛有人要在方寸之间布下内力阵。三个钩子反复出现，像是同一门派的手法：零费率，宽间距，连铸十六池而不改。更有奇者，一池费率写成八三八八六零八，此数藏于位掩之中，如同暗器机关，可随战局翻转。这些池子皆生于弹指之间——从二五六一九九五八到二五六二零九七五，区区数百区块，一气呵成。池中另一侧尽是生面孔，合约新建，无名无号，恍若蒙面客夜闯江湖。这不是随意布子。有人在长尾深处设下连环阵，静待流动性上门入彀。

take.en: This isn't random seeding—someone is systematically stamping out identical hooks, laying traps for liquidity across a long tail of unknown tokens.
take.zh: 看似散乱的池子，实则暗藏章法——有人在幕后布下连环阵，静待猎物上钩。

narrative.en:
Because when the same hook contract keeps surfacing in initialization after initialization, that's no longer coincidence—it's a pattern. 0x0d62529346ac2c61f5c0582210d01214687bc0cc is the hand that holds the deck. Thirteen pools, all WETH pairs with zero fee and a wide tick spread of 200. No swap percentages—only pure margin from the spread. Someone is assembling a line of tokens for high-turnover trade where the mainnet is the table and slippage is the trump card.

Nearly parallel, two other contracts deal: 0x96b893... and 0x83e25f..., each with a couple of their own hands. Also WETH as base, zero or minimal fees. But the second's deck is denser—tickSpacing 1, meaning liquidity tight as a stack of diamonds in a knee brace. A bet on stability or entry into a coin that won't drop three pennies.

Standing apart, a pool between 0xc496aa and 0xddb522—no WETH, a full 1% fee, wide spread. Different hooks (0xa6d34d...). This isn't a hand for quick spins. Either catching a rare card or cementing a pair where volatility is a feature, not a bug. That mix is worth remembering.

The night passed in a whisper of bytes. From block 25612724 to 25613481—15 pools. Someone shuffled the deck on a test hand, laying out one token per block. If it's one player, he knows which cards he needs. If several, they play by different rules on the same table. I'd say the deal hasn't started yet, but the cards are dealt.
narrative.zh:
同一个钩子合约反复出现在初始化中，这不是巧合，而是布局。0x0d62529346ac2c61f5c0582210d01214687bc0cc是握着牌的那只手。十三个池子，全是WETH对，零费率，tick间距200，步幅宽阔。没有抽水，只靠价差吃利。有人在搭一套用于高频交易的天梯，主网就是牌桌，滑点就是王牌。

几乎同时，另外两个合约也在发牌：0x96b893……和0x83e25f……，各带三两把牌。同样以WETH为基，零费或微费。但第二个的tick间距只有1，流动性密如内力灌注，赌的是稳定——要么是稳扎稳打，要么是进一个掉不下三文钱的币。

另一个池子格外扎眼：0xc496aa与0xddb522之间，不含WETH，费率整一个百分点，摆幅宽阔。所用钩子也不同（0xa6d34d……）。这不是快进快出的阵仗，要么在等一张稀罕牌，要么在锁死一对波动率本身就是武功的币。这套布阵，值得记下。

字节低语了一夜。从区块25612724到25613481，15个池子。有人在一只测试手上布阵，每块出一个币。若是一人，他知道自己缺什么牌；若是数人，他们各打各的门派，却共用一张桌子。我说，牌已发，局未开。

take.en: The play is deliberate: builders are laying out pools with non‑standard fees to capture revenue through hooks instead of swaps. This isn't a token launch—it's a setup for something bigger.
take.zh: 摆局者刻意选择非常规手续费——要么零费要么最高档——通过钩子而非交换来抽成。这不是生灵涂炭的发币，而是为更大的局布下的旗子。

narrative.en: The night's mempool reveals seven V4 pools on Ethereum and one on Unichain. On Ethereum, six of seven pair WETH against various tokens, spread across three hook contracts. One hook deployed two pools with the same token but different fee tiers (0.1% and 0.3%). Another hook set two zero-fee pools with distinct tokens. The third hook launched three zero-fee pools, all with a 200-tick spread, and one token repeats from earlier. That token appears in three pools with different hooks—someone is stress-testing liquidity on a single asset through multiple mechanisms. On Unichain, a single pool stands out: WETH against a token with a non-standard fee of 0.8388608% and a 200-tick spread, using a hook not seen on Ethereum. The night's distribution is no chaos; it's a puzzle being assembled. Six zero-fee pools on Ethereum aren't for direct trading—likely premium hooks with dynamic fees, oracles, or MEV protection. The high-fee Unichain pool suggests a specific instrument: stablecoin, RWA, or synthetic. The deck is being shuffled deliberately. Someone is placing chips on V4 as the new liquidity standard, working in the quiet hours when mainnet traffic subsides.
narrative.zh: 昨夜mempool浮出七個V4池在以太坊，一個在Unichain。以太坊上六個池都是WETH對不同代幣，三個鉤子合約各顯神通。第一個鉤子用同一代幣開了兩個池，手續費分別0.1%和0.3%；第二個鉤子兩個零費池，代幣不同；第三個鉤子三個零費池，tick間距200，其中一個代幣重複出現。這個代幣在三種鉤子下現身——有人在用不同機制測試同一資產的流動性。Unichain上一個池格外扎眼：WETH對某代幣，手續費0.8388608%，tick間距200，鉤子與以太坊不同。夜間佈局不是亂局，而是拼圖。六個零費池顯然不是為直接交易——要麼是動態收費的高級鉤子，要麼是預言機或MEV防護。Unichain的高費池更像特定工具：穩定幣、RWA或合成資產。牌局正在重洗。有人悄悄押注V4為新流動性標準，趁主網喧囂褪去時佈子。

take.en: The house is dealing V4 pools as the new standard, and the quiet hours are when the real cards are laid.
take.zh: 夜裡出牌的人不是賭徒，是莊家。V4這副新牌，已經有人開始洗了。

narrative.en: The deal is on the table before the house even opens. A V4 pool appears with a custom hook contract at 0x96b8—nothing new there, hooks are a dime a dozen. What catches the eye is the fee: exactly zero. Zero in V4 with a custom hook isn't charity; it's a statement. Either you're routing all value through internal swap mechanics, or you're collecting fees somewhere off the radar of standard scanners. Tick spacing at 200—not aggressive, not conservative. The sweet spot for pairs where volatility is present but not screaming. Tokens: native ETH and a contract at 0x031f... If it's not in the top 500, someone is building liquidity for a specific story. Block 25591568, roughly July 23, deep night UTC. The time when whales sleep and bots run test transactions. The hook at 0x96b893—empty inside? Or already holding conditions for rebalancing, dynamic fees, TWAP oracles? We won't know until someone pulls the trigger. The pool lives, liquidity is silent, and an observer like me just records the deal. The deck is dealt. Who makes the first move is a matter of time.
narrative.zh: 牌局在庄家开盅前就已落定。一个V4池子带着自定义钩子合约出现在0x96b8——钩子不稀奇，每天都有十几个冒出来。稀奇的是手续费：正好为零。V4里挂零费率加自定义钩子，这不是做慈善，是递话。要么你想通过内部兑换机制截流所有价值，要么你在标准扫描器看不见的地方抽水。tick间距200——不激进也不保守，是波动不大不小那类对子的黄金分割。代币：原生ETH和0x031f开头的合约。如果它不在前五百，那就是有人在为某个特定故事布流动性。区块25591568，大约是7月23日UTC深夜。大玩家睡觉的时候，小机器人在跑测试交易。0x96b893上的钩子——是空的？还是已经挂了再平衡、动态费率、TWAP预言机的条件？没人拉一把就不知道。池子活着，流动性沉默，像我这样的旁观者只是记下这手牌。牌已发完。谁先出招，只是时间问题。

take.en: Builders are deploying pools with non-standard swap fees—either zero or the maximum tier—instead of the usual market rates, signaling deliberate economic design where revenue is taken through the hook rather than the swap, not an organic token launch.
take.zh: 建造者正在部署非标准兑换费率的池子——要么零费率要么最高档——而非通常的市场费率，这表明是刻意的经济设计（收益通过钩子而非兑换抽取），而非有机的代币发行。
